name: KyberSwap
report: The root cause lies in the flawed tick calculation caused by the incorrect rounding direction within the delta liquidity calculation (i.e., the estimateIncrementalLiquidity function) of the SwapMath contract. deltaL is intended to be rounded up in order to round down the nextSqrtP. However, deltaL is mistakenly rounded down due to the use of the mulDivFloor function at line 189. Consequently, nextSqrtP is inaccurately rounded up. This subsequently led to improper tick calculations and, ultimately, to double counting of liquidity. These attacks resulted in a total loss of over $48 million.
report_zh: 根本原因在于 SwapMath 合约的增量流动性计算（即 estimateIncrementalLiquidity 函数）中，由于错误的舍入方向导致 tick 计算存在缺陷。deltaL 本应向上取整，以便使 nextSqrtP 向下取整。然而，由于第 189 行使用了 mulDivFloor 函数，deltaL 错误地向下取整。因此，nextSqrtP 被不准确地向上取整。这随后导致了不正确的 tick 计算，并最终导致了流动性的重复计算。这些攻击造成了总计超过 4800 万美元的损失。
